description: The posts in one subreddit, the way Reddit lists them: hot, new, rising or top (top takes a timeframe: hour, day, week, month, year, all). Each post: title, text, author, upvotes, comment count, flair, time and link. Use it to see what a community is talking about right now; reddit_post_comments reads the thread under one post, search_reddit searches by keyword. Pages with `after`. Spends about a credit per page.

after.description: the next-page token a previous call returned

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

subreddit.description: the subreddit, e.g. smallbusiness or r/smallbusiness

name: reddit_subreddit_feed
title: Read a subreddit's feed
